notes.mct_temperature: Per fold, the fused MCT temperature is fitted on the stacked (clean + degraded) inner OOF logits of the four MCT models.
notes.tau: Primary: operating_point on the stacked MCT OOF (both copies). Sensitivity: clean copy only.
notes.cost: Escalated clips charged C_ALL; others charged the A1 stage-1 cost (as run_cascade_orders).
notes.slg: Monitors are the clean-fit input monitors of run_qag; SLG marks depend only on them, so the marks are identical in both regimes (asserted).
notes.oracle: Known-condition active set, as in run_qag.oracle.
